purpose: Complete the Financial Ledger command and projection surface consumed by learning and personal day context.
success_outcome: Authorized payment commands deterministically allocate exact amounts, preserve audit and retry safety, and expose markers without changing payment, allocation, or balance state.
anti_goals: Teachers cannot edit or cancel payments.
Marker projection cannot mutate financial records or derive balances from presentation data.
constraints: Admin authority is center-scoped; teacher authority is assigned-class scoped and create-only.
Projection reads are non-financial and replay-stable.
invariants: Oldest uncovered charges are allocated first.
Repeated submission creates no second payment without explicit confirmation.
verification_targets: FT-006-AC-002: decimal replay with oldest-debt allocation and identical balance/allocation for identical input sequence.
FT-006-AC-003: full, partial, and excess payment scenarios with exact remainder/advance and paid/overdue assertions.
FT-006-AC-005: Admin/Teacher authority matrix, Admin payment edit/cancel recomputation and audit, assigned-class restriction, and cross-center negative scenarios.
FT-006-AC-006: marker projection at week/month boundary with factual date, multiple-marker retention, and non-mutation comparison.
FT-006-AC-007: repeated-submission retry scenario with payment-count assertion and explicit-confirmation branch.

stop_conditions: Stop if a payment operation requires bypassing Financial Ledger ownership.
